tagline: Starter scaffold — copy this directory and rename to onboard a new tenant.
_notes: This is the canonical starter for new directions (ADR-035). Do NOT deploy from this directory.
Adding a direction: cp -r directions/_template directions/<slug> && set slug, displayName and brand; keep deployment and legal empty at tier 1, or the Figma gate refuses it.
A client's brand never starts here: it is applied in the client's own repository through @hirobius/design-system/brand (docs/CONSUMING.md section 12).
